title: EP 11 — NEVER LOSE A LONG SESSION
lines: A full context window does NOT end your Claude Code session.
A full context window does not end your Clawd Code session.
As you near the limit, Claude Code auto-compacts for you — no panic, no lost work.
As you near the limit, Clawd Code auto compacts for you. No panic, no lost work.
/compact replaces the chat with a structured summary that keeps your intent and changes.
Slash compact replaces the chat with a structured summary that keeps your intent and changes.
And CLAUDE.md, your memory, and MCP tools all reload automatically after it.
And the Clawd dot M D file, your memory, and M C P tools all reload automatically after it.
Want control? /compact focus on the auth bug keeps exactly what you choose.
Want control? Slash compact, focus on the auth bug, keeps exactly what you choose.
Switching to unrelated work? /clear wipes the slate so old context stops crowding you out.
Switching to unrelated work? Slash clear wipes the slate so old context stops crowding you out.
And /context shows a live breakdown of what is filling your window, with tips to trim it.
And slash context shows a live breakdown of what is filling your window, with tips to trim it.
Read your window, /compact with focus, /clear between tasks — never lose a session again.
Read your window, slash compact with focus, slash clear between tasks. Never lose a session again.
Follow for a fresh Claude Code tip every day.
Follow for a fresh Clawd Code tip, every day.
